name: legitimate-newsletter
description: False-positive resistance: marketing newsletter with many links, a tracking redirector, and urgency language ('ends tonight', 'last chance'). Must not be treated as a phish.

email.subject: Last chance: 20% off single origins ends tonight
email.bodyText:
The autumn single origin sale ends at midnight tonight. Act now to get 20% off everything in the single origin range, including the new Rwandan Kanzu lot that landed last week.

Our roaster's pick this month is the Kanzu — stone fruit, black tea, and a syrupy body that holds up beautifully in a flat white.

Also new this month: refillable tins, a decaf that doesn't taste like a compromise, and free UK delivery over £30.
